unpinned.form: The live adapter supplies unpinned Form defaults at Open. It can derive fields from the opened point, library and aliases, and leave fields that require operator input blank.
unpinned.point: The tool-owned fixture/result/ftf-demo documents supply unpinned point values and global context. The synthetic R1 GE classifier, the low-shot simulated mux classifiers, the 0-degree Local Z pair and the shared CZ arb are path-timing inputs, not physical calibrations. Simulator and board inputs are the adjacent ftf-settings.yaml and board-profile.yaml.
